Characters

Harmony

Harmony
Harmony is a half-elf druid, a skill she takes up from her mother she woefully despises. Her favorite form are mice, whom she often spends her free time chatting with. Often known for her kindness, she tries her best to do what she believes is the right thing, even if it means putting herself in danger. However, her naivety puts her in just as much risk.

Zethria

Zethria
A stealthy rogue tiefling known for her card tricks and skulking footsteps. Zethria's broken horn gives her a distinctive appearance, standing out from other tieflings. Zethria spends her days in oberservation, making calculated decisions and striking when the time is right. When night falls, she heads to the tavern, where she rigs betting card games in her favor on drunken townsfolk.

Theseus

Theseus
A goliath paladin of immense strength. Theseus swings his sword with a force that could cleave stone itself. Enemies tremble beneath his voice, and sit stamped out under his heel. However, where Theseus shows strength on the battlefield, he wields it selfishly, often cruel in his actions. Losing his parents at a young age and being manipulated all his life, Theseus is still learning to come around to a life of independency

Aavarin

Aavarin
Aavarin is an air genasi and youngest of the group. His blurred past comes to him in bits and pieces while he tries to build a new life for himself often seeing the people around him as a family. Learning the fate of the realms, Aavarin took up magic as a means to fight back against horrors that dare defy him, and to help finally find his parents.
